part1.label: Project Fit First
part1.title: Start Your Project Review
part1.text: Share the essentials first: location, project type, goals, budget direction, timing, and known conditions. We review project fit before recommending a technical site assessment or the next design step.

part2.label: How It Works
part2.heading: A clearer first step for substantial residential projects.
part2.text1: The review is designed to make the first conversation more useful and avoid scheduling a site visit before the basic project fit is understood.
part2.text2: Tell us the location, scope, goals, budget direction, and timing.
part2.text3: We look at geography, project type, scale, budget direction, timing, available information, and overall working fit.
part2.text4: If it looks aligned, we clarify goals, constraints, and what information is still needed.
part2.text5: When appropriate, we move into a site assessment, feasibility work, or design planning.

part1.heading: Is the project a good fit?
part1.text2: Silver Peak specializes in substantial residential projects where design decisions, existing conditions, permitting, and construction need to be coordinated carefully. Priority projects are whole-house builds and rebuilds, additions, DADUs and ADUs, and basement remodels; select kitchens, bathrooms, exteriors, porches, restoration, carpentry, and tile work follow when the fit is right.
part1.short1: Whole house renovations, additions, rebuilds, ADUs, DADUs, and major basement projects
part1.short2: North Seattle and select northern / Eastside communities
part1.short3: A realistic budget direction that matches the intended scope
part1.short4: Homeowners who value planning, communication, craftsmanship, and a coordinated process

part3.label: Project Details
part3.heading: Tell us what you are planning.
part3.text: You do not need every answer. Share what you know now and we can identify the next questions together.

part4.label: Local Focus
part4.heading: North Seattle & Eastside, generally north of I-90.
part4.text: Silver Peak serves North Seattle and Eastside communities north of I-90. Our primary northern focus includes North Seattle, Bothell, Mill Creek, and Woodinville. We also consider select projects in Redmond and Kirkland when the location, scope, budget, timing, and overall fit make sense. On the Eastside, we prefer projects north of SR 520 when possible.
